title: Stereotaxic Surgery Protocol
author: Andrew Miller-hansen
materials: Get ice to transport virus aliquots.
Write down mouse cages you will use.
Grab personal supplies (wildcard, phone, surgery sheet, DIY opto probes).
Weigh activated charcoal canister (isoflurane collection cylinder).
Adjust mouse’s limbs to a more comfortable position.
Adjust ear bars to secure skull.
Scrape until bregma and lambda are clear.
If doing implants, use scrapper to score skull.
Plan your movements to avoid damaging needle.

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Equipment
steps.instruction: Verify availability of virus aliquots, buprenorphine (Ethiqa XR, 3.25mg/kg), and Meloxicam (Converturs, 20mg/kg).

substeps.instruction: Dilute viruses with sterile saline if necessary (using a 10 ul pipette).
Turn on the bead sterilizer (germinator); wait ~1h until the green LED turns ON.
Check isoflurane levels in the anesthesia machine and oxygen gas pressure.
Ensure stereotax arms are firmly secured.

steps.title: Gather Sterile Supplies
steps.instruction: Collect necessary materials on a sterile pad.

substeps.instruction: Gather syringes of buprenorphine (3.25mg/kg) and meloxicam (20mg/kg), Nair, Betadine, cotton swabs, triangle sponges, alcohol wipes, scalpel blade, Parafilm, Vetbond, eye ointment, ear tags/tagger, sutures, and a waste beaker/black bag.
Sterilize metal tools in the germinator for ~20 s: skull scrapper, scalpel, forceps, hemostat with scissors (2 for sutures, 1 for implants), and small scissors (for implants).
If performing implants, gather: porcelain dish, Metabond powder with white scoop, Metabond liquid, Metabond catalyst, green applicators, and Flow-It ALS Light-Curing cement.

steps.title: Initialize Hardware
steps.instruction: Power on and configure the surgical equipment.

substeps.instruction: Turn ON lights, drill, digital stereotaxic display, syringe pump controller, and heating pads (battery plug-in at setting 4; recovery pad at medium).
Clean NanoFil syringes with water then saline using a 24-well plate.
Insert NanoFil syringes into pumps, adjusting the plunger to fit; replace needles if they are large gauge (brand new) or bent.

steps.title: Induce Anesthesia
steps.instruction: Prepare the anesthesia machine and induce the mouse.

substeps.instruction: Loosen screws for nose press and iso mask; expose the bite hole in the bite bar.
Open oxygen gas tank and turn ON the anesthesia machine (ON/OFF and system pressure switches).
Set iso vaporizer to 4 and turn ON flow switches for the induction chamber.
Place mouse in induction chamber for 30 s to 1 min; monitor breathing.
Once breathing slows to ~1 breath/s, turn OFF induction flow switches and turn ON iso mask flow switches.

steps.title: Secure Mouse in Stereotax
steps.instruction: Position the mouse and maintain anesthesia.

substeps.instruction: Place mouse on the warm heating pad on the stereotax.
Scruff mouse, pry mouth open with a cotton swab, and place top teeth on the bite bar.
Position the iso mask over the nose; adjust side screw if needed to avoid suffocation.
Apply eye ointment to prevent drying.
Secure ear bars in the grooves (not inside the ear canal), adjusting height and head inclination for symmetry and stability.
Verify head is immobile by attempting to move it side-to-side with fingers.
Monitor breathing and pain (toe pinches); adjust iso flow rate accordingly. Iso level may be dropped to 1-2% as surgery progresses.
Swap heating pad batteries if low.

steps.title: Prepare Surgical Site
steps.instruction: Remove fur and disinfect the skull area.

substeps.instruction: Apply Nair from behind ears to behind eyes with a cotton swab; let sit for 15-30 s.
Rotate swab against the grain to remove fur, then clean any Nair near eyes with a new swab.
Remove all Nair and fur using alcohol wipes.
Apply Betadine to exposed skin with a soaked cotton swab, moving remaining fur away from the operative area.
Remove Betadine and leftover fur with an alcohol wipe.
Perform a toe squeeze and pinch to confirm full anesthesia.

steps.title: Perform Craniotomy
steps.instruction: Expose the skull and drill target holes.

substeps.instruction: Make a midline incision (~1-2 cm) from eyes to ears using a scalpel (larger incision or skin removal if doing implants).
Clean tissue from skull using a skull scrapper and triangle sponges/cotton swabs.
Attach drill to stereotax arm and zero at bregma (projected intersection of sutures on top of midline).
Verify skull is level: lambda should be within ±0.1 of bregma in the z-plane (DV); adjust head inclination if necessary.
Move drill to desired coordinates (do not rely solely on digital +/- values).
Drill through skull until the ball tip is through; ensure cortex is visible without damaging it.
Absorb bleeding with triangle sponges. For implants, remove debris/blood clots using a drop of saline and a scrapper.
If doing implants, further score the skull with a scalpel and dry with ethanol wipe and sponges.

steps.title: Prepare Virus Injection
steps.instruction: Load the syringe with the virus.

substeps.instruction: Replace drill with the syringe holder; adjust arm up and away from ear bars.
Configure syringe controller: select pump > CONFIGURE > RESET POS > END STOP > SET STOP. Set volume target and delivery rate.
Use CONTINUOUS INFUSE to push plunger in, then use MOMENTARY WITHDRAW/INFUSE to fill and test.
Place Parafilm on mouse's head; spin virus in bench centrifuge (< 2 s) and pipet ~double the required volume onto Parafilm.
Aspirate virus into the needle using MOMENTARY WITHDRAW; eject and re-aspirate if bubbles are present.
Discard Parafilm into biohazard waste.

steps.title: Inject Virus
steps.instruction: Deliver the virus to the target brain coordinates.

substeps.instruction: Zero the needle at bregma and move to desired coordinates.
Perform a test ejection of a small amount of virus using MOMENTARY INFUSE and absorb with a sponge.
Lower needle slowly (min 0.1 mm/s), going 0.1 mm deeper than the target DV position, then move up to the target.
Press RUN to inject virus.
Leave needle in place for 5 min (avoid hitting the table).
Raise needle 0.1 mm, wait 5-10 s, and repeat to minimize vacuum and dorsal spread.
Slowly withdraw needle (min 0.1 mm/s).
Eject a small amount of virus to clean the tip once clear of the skull; absorb with a sponge.
Repeat for additional injections.

steps.title: Suture Incision
steps.instruction: Close the skin using a surgeon's knot.

substeps.instruction: Re-hydrate skin with a drop of saline and remove excess with a sponge.
Slightly relax ear bars.
Use left hemostat to pull suture until a 3-4 cm tail remains.
Use left hemostat to grab the long end 5-10 cm from the incision.
Wrap right hemostat 2-3x clockwise around the suture, pull the tail through the loop, and release.
Wrap right hemostat 1-2x counterclockwise, grab tail, and pull to create a square knot.
Wrap right hemostat 1-2x clockwise, grab tail, and pull to finish the surgeon's knot.
Cut suture ends (~0.3 cm) and repeat for 1-2 additional knots.

steps.title: Post-Surgical Recovery
steps.instruction: Finalize the procedure and move the mouse to recovery.

substeps.instruction: Release ear bars, remove iso mask, and remove mouse from bite bar.
Apply Vetbond to sutured skin while holding the head up to protect eyes.
Apply ear tag if needed.
Place mouse in a heated recovery bin and turn OFF the iso mask flow switches.
Provide wet food (DietGel) or moistened dry food in the cage.
Fill out the green surgery card and place it in front of the cage card.
Monitor for recovery (grooming is a good indicator) before returning to the home cage.
Check animal 24 h later for lethargy, coat condition, or open mouth breathing.

steps.title: Implant Probes (If Applicable)
steps.instruction: Install probes and secure with Metabond and cement.

substeps.instruction: Score skull further and dry with alcohol wipes/sponges; remove blood clots with forceps.
Insert probe into a cannula holder (with white ferrule holder), loosening the grip by inserting/removing a few times.
Attach holder to stereotax arm; zero probes at bregma and implant the probe furthest from bregma first.
Lower probe slowly to target (DV position 0.1 mm above virus injection).
In a cold porcelain dish, mix 1 scoop Metabond powder, 2 drops liquid, and 1 drop catalyst.
Apply mixture with a green applicator to the exposed fiber optic and ferrule, letting it run to the skull; ensure fiber is completely covered.
Avoid applying Metabond to the ferrule or cannula holder; wipe off immediately if contaminated.
Wait ~5 min for Metabond to dry; verify with a skull scrapper.
Gently raise the cannula holder with forceps to ensure the probe is secure.
Apply Flow-It ALC Light Curing Cement around and between probes, leaving 5 mm of each ferrule exposed.
Cure cement with UV light (shield eyes with red cover), moving the light around the cement hill.
Check smoothness with a skull scrapper and optionally apply Vetbond to seal skin.
Remove mouse to heated recovery bin and turn OFF iso mask flow switches.

steps.title: Cleanup and Storage
steps.instruction: Clean the workstation and store remaining materials.

substeps.instruction: Collect leftover virus from syringes or empty them using continuous infuse.
Clean NanoFil syringes with saline then water.
Store leftover carpofen in the fridge.
Discard scalpel blades and sutures in the sharps container.
Clean metal tools, ear bars, bite bar, drill, and heating pad cover with alcohol wipes.
Close oxygen tank.
Clean recovery bin and induction chamber with CDOX sprayed paper towels.
Air out empty iso bottles in the hood before placing in glass waste.
Place Bose speaker on charging platform and store ice bucket/buprenorphine in the histology room.
Thaw virus stock slowly on ice in a tube rack with 0.5 ml eppendorf tubes.
Once thawed (~30 min), spin stock in bench centrifuge for ~2 s.
Pipette stock up and down, then make 5 and/or 10 ul aliquots, changing tips frequently.
Label tubes with color-coded labels by volume and label the storage box with titer and date.
Open side screw (B) and place fill device adaptor (C) into the fill hole (D), facing up and away from the side screw.
Close side screw (B) tightly.
Move iso bottle up until the adaptor fills with iso.
Turn fill knob (E) to OPEN until iso reaches max level (F), then turn to CLOSE.
Move bottle down to empty the adaptor, open side screw (B), and remove adaptor.
Close adaptor cap and store in the hood; mark tank label as 'empty' or 'in use'.
